dataset_title: Copernicus DEM GLO-30 Public — western Pyrenean tile set

derived_artifacts.role: Terrain descriptor: extent, placement, intervals and attribution for the Atlas

geographic_extent.description: Six pinned 1°×1° tiles covering the western Pyrenees, the Béarn foothills and the Adour basin. CARTA acquires only the tiles the Béarn / Jurançon proof needs; no France-wide elevation ingestion exists.

geographic_meaning: Digital surface model of the western Pyrenees: bare ground plus vegetation canopy and buildings as observed by TanDEM-X between 2011 and 2015. It is physical relief context for CARTA Atlas. It is not evidence about vineyard land, planted parcels, growing conditions, ripening, drainage, climate or wine quality.

measurement.native_resolution: 1 arc-second grid (3600×3600 samples per 1° tile); ≈30 m north–south and ≈23 m east–west at 43°N
measurement.scale_limitations: Usable for regional relief reading down to roughly 1:50,000. It cannot resolve an individual vineyard parcel, a terrace, a wall or a row orientation, and as a surface model it carries tree canopy and building heights as if they were ground.
measurement.uncertainty: Per-tile absolute vertical accuracy LE90 between 1.741 m and 1.971 m (LE68 1.468–1.642 m) as reported by the Copernicus tile accuracy masks; the programme specification is LE90 < 4 m vertical and CE90 < 6 m horizontal.

notes: Acquired from the AWS Open Data cloud-optimised mirror of COP-DEM_GLO-30-DGED. The mirror repackages the ESA delivery: it drops the shared east and south edge row and column (3601→3600 samples) and adds DEFLATE-compressed COG overviews. Every acquired file is pinned by SHA-256 in source_files, and each downloaded byte stream was additionally checked against the object ETag published by the mirror. The mirror does not publish an ESA release identifier, so this manifest pins the 2022-05-09 mirror snapshot rather than asserting a release number CARTA cannot verify.
publisher: Copernicus programme — European Union and ESA (data © DLR e.V. and Airbus Defence and Space GmbH)
refresh_policy: Pinned snapshot. CARTA re-acquires only when a Copernicus DEM release changes the western Pyrenean tiles, or when a proof needs an extent these six tiles do not cover. Terrain is context, not a live feed, so there is no scheduled refresh.
